# developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Risk And Security — Chargebacks Retrievals

> 4 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Risk And Security under Chargebacks Retrievals. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Chargebacks Retrievals

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/chargebacks-retrievals/overview): Chargebacks are a standard part of doing business, especially if you accept payments online. But don't worry – we're here to help!
- [Disputing Chargebacks](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/chargebacks-retrievals/disputing-chargebacks): If one of your customers issues a chargeback through their bank, you have the chance to dispute it and win back the funds.
- [Reducing Chargebacks](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/chargebacks-retrievals/reducing-chargebacks): While it’s impossible to prevent chargebacks entirely, there are steps you can take to significantly reduce their frequency.
- [American Express](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/chargebacks-retrievals/chargeback-reason-codes): All received credit card disputes include a reason code. Reason codes vary by card brand.
